newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 28,000/T Feb heavy naphtha.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 28,000/T Feb heavy naphtha.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 28,000 tonnes of heavy naphthenic and aromatic (N+A) naphtha for February 1-28 delivery to Kaohsiung.
The tender closes December 30 and is valid until December 31.
In its last spot tender for similar grade naphtha, CPC bought one 28,000 tonne cargo at $230.00 per tonne on a cost-and-freight basis to Kaohsiung for November 21-30 delivery.
CPC has a one-year term agreement to buy 360,000 tonnes of N+A naphtha. The 1997 term contract was concluded late November at $3.40-$3.50 per tonne over Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis.
